product.title: Barcelona Private Sailing with Open Bar & Snacks (max 9)

description.text: Enjoy a peaceful day sailing off the coast of Barcelona by opting for a private sailing tour. Take the stress out of being on noisy, crowded boats by having a boat to yourself and your group. Stops include Port Olímpic, Barcelona coastline, Mediterranean Sea. You won’t have to worry about steering the ship or navigating, as a skipper joins you. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
